pullRequest.title: Allow lookup by request parameter
pullRequest.body: Look up a user by numeric ID without changing authorization behaviour.

reviewComments.body: The raw `id` is now inserted into the SQL text. A caller can inject additional SQL here; please keep this as a bound parameter.

reviews.body: The response mapping should also be checked for callers that expect missing users to return 404.

issueComments.body: I reviewed the rollout notes and did not find any deployment concerns.
